items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: my dad called and said, “Lanny, Stan wants you to come on the band.”

ctx.x: The Ferguson band seemed to be one of the hottest things going. That was 13 pieces? Thirteen, 14?

Thirteen pieces. Well I think it was. I may be a little prejudiced. I think at times during that particular band’s lifetime, which was probably 1957 through when he left New York which was early ’66, I think that band was maybe four, five times — nobody could touch it. It was the hottest band in the world, and I’m including everybody. Actually I played with that band in 1957 before I went in the service. Willie Maiden was an old friend of mine. And he was playing baritone on the band and he got sick one night,…
